hook: The reintroduction protocol. How you bring stimulation back determines whether the reset holds.
topic: Structured reintroduction of inputs after a reset
body:
**The reintroduction protocol. How you bring stimulation back after a reset is more important than the reset itself.**

Most people come out of a detox with a lower threshold, better focus, and better mornings — and then allow inputs to return at the same volume and pattern as before. The threshold is back within two weeks. The reset served as a cleanse, not a restructuring.

The reintroduction phase is where permanent change is available. You're coming in with a recalibrated baseline and a window to establish new defaults before the old patterns reassert. That window is short. Use it deliberately.

The protocol: reintroduce inputs one tier at a time, starting with medium-stimulus before high. Introduce with time limits and defined contexts — social media has a time slot, not a constant presence. Any input that returns to compulsive, context-free use is a signal it came back too fast, at too high a volume.

The goal is not zero stimulation permanently. It's a maintained relationship with inputs that doesn't cost you your focus. Intention over impulse, at every reintroduction decision.

The full reintroduction checklist is in the link in bio.
